In Islamic tradition, the name Daylam is associated with the people of the mountainous region of Daylam in Nijd, Saudi Arabia. The name is also used to refer to a tribe that originated from this region. In terms of personality, people with the name Daylam are often associated with being strong, brave, and determined.
